title: From Global Evidence to Saudi Practice: A Structured Evidence Map of the Diagnosis, Molecular Targets, and Therapeutic Strategies of Multiple Sclerosis in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
snippet: Multiple sclerosis (MS) has shifted in a generation from an uncommon diagnosis in Saudi Arabia to a major cause of neurological disability in young adults.
